summary: Nogon is a self-hosted personal search engine that automatically indexes the websites you visit. It offers local file indexing, multi-user support, offline result previews, and optional semantic search capabilities.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams wanting a private, searchable local archive of their web browsing history and documents without relying on external services.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 license requires you to share modifications if you offer the software as a network service, and automatic indexing may demand significant storage over time.
deployNotes: Because it is distributed as a Docker container written in Go, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for the search index and place it behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
